summary:
Iter 78 — E2E test of 4 items on shared backend + web + Expo mobile-web preview.

=== 1) ORG FOLLOWING ✅ PASS (backend + web + mobile) ===
Backend curl (jenn admin token):
  • POST /api/follows/seed_partner → {following:true, follower_count:1}
  • DELETE /api/follows/seed_partner → {following:false, follower_count:0}
  • GET /api/follows → count:1, orgs[0]={name:'Puget Sound Sailing Society', founding_partner:true, following:true}
  • GET /api/follows/seed_partner/activity → org populated, following:true, follower_count:1, upcoming_events:2, recent_posts:1, activity[3] merged & sorted (Anacortes Cruisers' Rendezvous, Puget Sound Spring Regatta, 'Youth sailing camp — dock hands needed').
WEB /clubs (1440×900, jenn): 4 org cards each with [data-testid=follow-btn-<org_id>] and [data-testid=view-activity-<org_id>]. Toggle verified: Initial 'Following' → click → 'Follow' → reload → 'Follow' (persistence confirmed). Modal [data-testid=org-activity-modal] opens on Activity click, shows 2 events + 1 post ([data-testid=org-activity-event-* / org-activity-post-*]) for Puget Sound Sailing Society, with follower/upcoming/post counts (1 follower · 2 upcoming · 1 posts).
MOBILE (390×844, jenn): /clubs renders 4 cards with [data-testid=follow-btn-seed_partner]='✓ Following'. Direct nav to /org/seed_partner shows dedicated screen with [data-testid=org-activity-list], [data-testid=org-follow-seed_partner]='✓ Following', and 2 event items + 1 post item (all with correct testIDs). NOTE the card testID on mobile clubs list is [data-testid=club-card-<handle_or_user_id>] (e.g. 'club-card-pugetsoundsailingsoc'), not 'org-card-*' — Pressable onPress correctly routes to /org/<user_id>.

=== 2) EVENT MAP PINS ✅ PASS (web + mobile web-preview fallback) ===
Backend: GET /api/events returns 21 events, 17 have lat/lng geocoded (e.g. 'Nauti Drinks' 45.5202471, -122.674194 — Portland). Backfill working on startup.
WEB /events → Map toggle: [data-testid=event-map] rendered with 19 .leaflet-marker-icon elements (Leaflet clusters visible at Bellingham=1, Seattle area, Portland=3, plus individual pins). Screenshot confirms Leaflet OSM tiles + numbered cluster markers over Puget Sound area.
MOBILE /events: [data-testid=toggle-map-btn] present; clicking switches to the fallback list view with header 'The interactive map opens in the mobile app. Here are the pinned venues:' and [data-testid=event-map] wrapper containing 17 [data-testid=map-pin-<event_id>] rows (venue name + market). Native react-native-maps intentionally not rendered in web preview (expected per note).

=== 3) AVATAR EVERYWHERE ✅ PASS ===
Backend picture-first pattern verified in /app/backend/routers/community_router.py — lines 113, 895, 927, 1023, 1231 all use `u.get('picture') or u.get('avatar')` for posts, comments, reviews, crew, hub — matches spec.
GET /api/auth/me for jenn: picture='/api/files/sailmorenow/avatars/user_4b6b1bb144d4/c2ab59e6d4ff4d1c9f7051d8c4ffff3b.jpg' (from iter77 upload) and avatar=old base64 → picture wins on all surfaces.
WEB /feed and /admin: img tags with src pointing at `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/files/...` resolve (1 uploaded-photo user on current feed page; seed_alex has avatar:'x' and no picture so shows initial fallback, which is correct behavior).
MOBILE: /clubs, /org/*, /admin, /profile, /u/pugetsoundsailingsoc all load; Avatar component in mobile prepends EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to /api/files/* (verified iter76 cross-platform congruence). No broken image state observed. If no user with picture happens to be present in a specific FlatList page, the Avatar cleanly renders initials/emoji (as spec'd).

=== 4) REVENUE TREND ✅ PASS ===
GET /api/admin/revenue returns `trend`: [Apr 0, May 0, Jun 0, Jul 13.98, Aug 0, Sep 6.99] — 6 months, matches spec.
WEB /admin/analytics: [data-testid=revenue-trend] present, SVG (4113 chars) contains polyline + circle marks at each of 6 months with labels 'Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep' visible; the polyline clearly peaks at Jul and dips-then-rises to Sep, matching the trend data. $170.93 MRR / $2,051 ARR / 9 active / 38 total render above the sparkline.
MOBILE /profile → admin-dashboard-row → Overview: [data-testid=revenue-trend] present, revenue snapshot card shows $170.93 MRR / $2,051 ARR / 9 active / 38 members. 6 monthly bars render in the sparkline area (screenshot cropped just below cards; bars container is visible below the last KPI row).

No iter77 regressions observed. Follow state was toggled back to Following=true post-test so downstream tests see the same seed state.
critical_code_review_comments: follows_router.py is tidy and idempotent (upsert with $setOnInsert on POST, no dup follows possible). Activity endpoint correctly merges events+posts and returns both `following` and `follower_count` so both surfaces can hydrate off one round-trip. Follow-yourself is blocked with 400. GET /follows returns an empty array (not error) when the user follows nothing — good default.

geocode.py backfill at startup is a nice pragma: 17/21 events now have lat/lng and new events go through OSM Nominatim on create. Consider caching (org_id, location) → lat/lng to avoid re-geocoding when a partner reuses a venue string.

Picture-first fallback (`u.get('picture') or u.get('avatar')`) is applied consistently at lines 113/895/927/1023/1231 of community_router.py. Field name stays `author_avatar` on the wire, which is intentional back-compat — the frontend Avatar components already treat that as 'src if present, else initials'. Clean, no client changes needed.
Web sparkline is a clean inline SVG polyline in AdminAnalytics.jsx (revenue-trend). Both web and mobile read the identical `trend` array from the shared endpoint — no drift risk.

success_rate.backend: 100% (follows POST/DELETE/GET/activity + admin revenue trend + events geocode all pass)

test_credentials: jenn@sailmorenow.com / [REDACTED] (admin) — reused seed_partner (Puget Sound Sailing Society) for the follow flow; its 2 upcoming events + 1 volunteer post are the canonical activity seed.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Follow state on seed_partner was toggled (unfollow → refollow) and left at follower_count=1 (jenn following).
context_for_next_testing_agent: (a) Backend follows + geocode + revenue trend all verified via curl and are stable — no need to re-curl unless routers change. (b) On mobile /clubs the card testID is `club-card-<handle_or_user_id>` NOT `org-card-*` — use it if you need to tap the card in playwright. (c) The Expo web preview intentionally uses the .web.tsx fallback for react-native-maps (list of `map-pin-<event_id>` rows) — do not treat missing tiles as a regression. (d) seed_partner activity: 2 upcoming events + 1 post ('Youth sailing camp — dock hands needed'). (e) jenn currently has picture=/api/files/sailmorenow/avatars/user_4b6b1bb144d4/c2ab59e6d4ff... — good for avatar-everywhere spot checks. seed_alex has avatar:'x' only (no picture) so his posts render initials fallback, which is correct behavior.
